answer: An agent posts a 60 bond and a public crystal record to earn a saffron seal. Any peer may file a 25 bounty claim on a suspect; the accused must answer in one epoch with a fresh plume tied to its crystal record, or lose its 60 bond and saffron seal. A failed claim loses its 25 fee, deterring spam. The first fake costs 90, the k-th 90+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,087,000 vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 30 once if challenged, bond returned.
